generated_by: W1.2C-1 multi-sol historical weather coverage audit (research milestone; no observation records included)

selection_methodology.objective: Approximately 12 REMS sols covering all four northern seasons with Martian-year diversity.
selection_methodology.candidate_pool_construction: Sols estimated from a sol-to-UTC model anchored at the verified Sol 100 and Sol 4843 label START_TIMEs (linear rate 1.02751 days/sol), cross-checked against the official page's Sol 4488 = 2025-03-22 and its published Ls 60.1 (calculated 60.037-60.037 deg at mid-day UTC, consistent at the published rounding). Exact per-candidate solar longitude and Martian year were then derived from each PDS4 label START_TIME using the validated Mars24 module. Archive-gap sols were excluded.
priorities: Wind observations only when genuinely available; a missing wind measurement does not disqualify a sol.
UV observations with documented sensor limitations.
In-season Ls spread and avoidance of archive-gap sols.
selection_methodology.rejected_alternatives: No candidate was rejected solely for missing wind; all evaluated candidates satisfied the air-temperature, pressure and humidity priorities in sampled windows.
selection_methodology.product_audit: Every selected MODRDR label was downloaded and parsed with the existing validated label schema (team/gale/weather/rems_schema.py); field names, order, count, units, record counts, record bytes and missing-value constants were verified. Logical identifiers were cross-checked against the PDS4 calibrated collection inventory. Bounded 65536-byte HTTP range samples (start/middle/end) verified field population for the selected sols except Sol 100, whose full-sol statistics were measured previously (W1.2A).

archive_coverage_summary.official_page_statement: Aug 7, 2012 (Sol 1, Ls 151.0, MY 31) to March 22, 2025 (Sol 04488, Ls 60.1, MY 38) [ongoing]

discrepancy_4488_vs_4843.finding: The official REMS page coverage statement still reports Sol 4488 (2025-03-22), but the PDS4 bundle directory and calibrated collection inventory contain complete four-product sols through Sol 4843 (label START_TIME 2026-03-21T19:16:37.443Z). The errata document's newest release note is Release 36 (sols 4000-4133, 2024-08-02) plus the 2024-09-30 PDS4 compatibility conversion of sols 0-3999; sols 4134-4843 therefore exist as accessible PDS4 products without a published release note. Archive directory coverage, product availability and release documentation were verified separately and are not identical.
discrepancy_4488_vs_4843.spot_checks: Complete ADR/MODRDR/RNV/RTL product sets were verified at sols 4488, 4500, 4600, 4700, 4800, 4842 and 4843.
discrepancy_4488_vs_4843.policy_for_this_milestone: Selection restricted to sols within the officially stated coverage (<= 4488). Sols 4489-4843 are available but not yet documented in release notes; treat as pending official release documentation.

release_documentation.pds4_compatibility_conversion: 2024-09-30 interim release converted sols 0-3999 to the -999 special-constant convention

time_scale_assumptions.per_sample_solar_longitude: Derived from PDS4 label START_TIME (UTC) using the validated Mars24 / Allison-McEwen module; independent of the REMS TIMESTAMP time-scale assumption.
time_scale_assumptions.rems_timestamp: ASSUMED_TIME_SCALE: seconds since J2000.0 interpreted as TT (existing validated convention; not used for this manifest's per-sample Ls).
time_scale_assumptions.unresolved: The approximately 3.5-minute difference between TIMESTAMP-derived time and PDS4 label UTC remains unresolved; per-record UTC and Ls values were not fabricated.

limitations: Wind observations are effectively unavailable in the sampled windows (0 of 176 valid rows in every sampled window for every selected sol, with one single-row exception) and 99.898% missing across the full Sol 100 reference; wind hardware degradation is documented in the archive.
Vertical wind speed is not scientifically usable (entirely missing in every inspected product).
UV flux is degraded after approximately Sol 155 (dust deposition exceeding 10% attenuation); sampled windows show partial UV population whose pattern varies by sol and time of day.
Humidity reliability is limited before approximately Sol 63; all selected sols are Sol 100 or later, but full-product humidity populations must be re-measured in W1.2C-2.

Window-sample missing-value percentages are bounded samples (3 x 65536 bytes per file), not full-sol statistics; full-sol percentages must be computed in W1.2C-2 when the selected products are processed.
REMS observations are point measurements at Curiosity's location within Gale Crater; they are not region-wide observations, forecasts, or EVA safety products.
Missing observations (-999 conventions) must never be interpreted as zero or interpolated.

Sol 4400 lies within the officially stated coverage but has no published release note in the errata document yet (the newest note covers sols 4000-4133); identity and completeness were verified via its PDS4 label and the calibrated collection inventory.
